en.title: Number of Idle Robots With Other Robots in All Four Axis Directions
en.description:
n robots stand at distinct integer coordinates. A robot is idle if another robot is to its left and another to its right in the same row, and another is above it and another below it in the same column. These robots do not need to be at distance 1, and there may be gaps in between. Find the number of idle robots.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of x y. The original bounds are 1≤n≤100000, −10^9≤x,y≤10^9, and the coordinate pairs are distinct.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 1, 0 and 0. In the first example no neighbor needs to be at distance 1, and the center robot is still idle.
hints: Record the minimum and maximum x of each row and the minimum and maximum y of each column; count a robot when its x lies strictly between its row's extremes and its y lies strictly between its column's extremes.
